question.text: 'Vasudha Accredited Opportunities AIF' is structured such that each investor commits a minimum capital contribution of INR 70 crore and has provided a waiver from PPM template and annual audit. Per the chapter, this exemption threshold (in INR or equivalent USD) is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 13.5.2, the minimum prescribed PPM template disclosures and annual audit requirements are not applicable to AIFs/Schemes in which each investor commits a minimum capital contribution of INR 70 crore (or USD 10 million equivalent in case of non-INR capital commitment) AND provides a waiver from the PPM template and annual audit requirements. The Trap: INR 25 crore and INR 50 crore are not the prescribed waiver thresholds. INR 100 crore relates to a separate Angel Fund audit threshold and is not the PPM-template waiver figure. Note: Both conditions are needed at the same time — the per-investor monetary threshold AND a written waiver from each such investor.
